fragments.text: This point should also be the object of public artificial intelligence policies. According to our research, when the cultural barriers to communication has a strong relationship with ethics. When cultural barriers and prejudices increase, ethics decrease and vice versa. When cultural barriers decrease, ethical behavior or the web increases. All these points have gained more strength during the pandemic of COVID-19, as home office war has increased and we have all become more dependent of the internet. We live in the time in a post-human world, but believe that technology alone will solve of any problems of humankind is the greatest mistake. We need multicultural, transdisciplinary and multi-sectorial strategies, policies and solutions to face the current challenges using artificial intelligence. New technologies also produce new ways of living and existing, but for this ethics is necessary and essential. Thank you very much for your attention and we keep in touch. Thank you again.
